line: Long day, I open up my phone to text you
Same second, your name lights up my screen
We both typed "you won't believe this"
Laughing at how in sync we've always been
I don't have to say it right
You already know what's on my mind
We're on the same page, same page
Even when the words get lost along the way
Some people need the whole story
You just need half a look
We're on the same page, same page
You can read me like your favorite book

You order mine before I even speak
I start a sentence, you finish it for me
Like we've been friends since we were three
